# pytest / Allure compatibility fixture

Generated 2026-09-27 with pytest 8.4.1 and allure-pytest 2.16.1 from the preserved `sample_business.py.txt` source, copied to a temporary directory as `sample_business.py`:

```sh
cp sample_business.py.txt sample_business.py
python -m pytest -q sample_business.py --junitxml=pytest.xml --alluredir=allure-results
```

Expected sample outcome: 2 passed, 1 intentional failure, 1 skipped. All inputs are synthetic. The image is a synthetic one-pixel diagnostic attachment, not a customer screenshot. Host/thread labels were removed from result JSON before packaging, and the XML hostname was replaced with `synthetic-runner`. No execution results were edited. `allure-results.zip` contains the adjacent results directory with fixed ZIP timestamps. UUIDs/timestamps are captured output, not deterministic identifiers.

These are real serializer outputs from synthetic tests; they do not establish real customer CI, business UAT, or model quality. The sample source is named to avoid automatic collection by the repository test suite. Regeneration requires allure-pytest only in the external fixture environment, not a new TAP runtime dependency.
